items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is a rinse-off wash that suits your request for clearer-looking skin, and it keeps things gentle on oily skin.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps support comfort and balance as your moisture score is on the lower side.

response.routine_note: Start with the wash once a day in the evening, then moisturizer, and use SPF every morning, building up only if your skin feels comfortable. As you are trying to conceive, I left out retinoids and strong acids, and it is worth checking your routine with your doctor or pharmacist.
